initial.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-A] Critical-asset schedule
initial.goal: Produce one accepted critical-asset schedule for the complete asset denominator.
initial.required_outcome: One accepted critical-asset schedule with provenance, ownership, licensing, trademark, and assignment dispositions. The asset validator proves every critical asset appears exactly once with an accepted disposition and redacted receipt.
authority_boundary: Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one critical-asset schedule; source-specific checks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.
No adjacent sprint or provider authority
operator_constraints: No paid cloud or provider mutation
No secrets, legal instruments, auth codes, or recovery factors in Git
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one critical-asset schedule; source-specific checks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.
deliverables: One accepted critical-asset schedule with provenance, ownership, licensing, trademark, and assignment dispositions.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every critical asset has an owner and disposition
AC-2: Private instruments remain outside Git
AC-3: Redacted receipts bind accepted instruments to the asset schedule
initial.plan_summary: Reconcile the issue boundary, produce the single CORP-A deliverable, validate it, and obtain exact-head review.

steps.action: Reconcile dependencies and freeze the exact issue-local denominator.
Produce the bounded primary deliverable without widening authority.
Run every planned PVF lane and retain bounded redacted evidence.
Obtain exact-head review and prepare a truthful publication handoff.

invariants: Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one critical-asset schedule; source-specific checks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.

risks: Counsel or corporate authority is missing

review_prompts: Does the implementation stay inside the declared unit boundary?
Does every acceptance criterion have proving evidence?
